As a domestic trip, no visa is required for Indian passport holders.

- Keep cash on hand; many beach shacks and small shops may not accept cards and UPI can be slow in crowded areas.
- Respect church dress codes in Old Goa – shoulders and knees should be covered.
- Only swim at beaches with lifeguard flags and avoid swimming after drinking.
